Eligibility Rules & References

Eligibility Rules

Fully Eligible: DOJ on or before 30 Sep 2025 (6 months prior to 31 Mar 2026)

Pro-Rata Eligible: DOJ between 01 Oct 2025 – 31 Mar 2026 (months worked / 12)

Not Eligible: DOJ after 31 Mar 2026

Industry Benchmark References

Aon Annual Salary Increase & Turnover Study 2024-25 PDF · SharePoint Increment-Trends-2025-2026.pdf PDF · SharePoint compup.io benchmark Web · Live Benchmark Tool

KRA / KPI Bulk Import

Upload a CSV or XLSX file to set KRA & KPI data for multiple employees at once.

Required columns: employeeEmail  kraName  kpiDescription  weightage  Optional — Self Assessment:  selfScore  selfComments  Optional — Manager Assessment:  managerScore  managerComments
Each row is one KPI/KRA. Multiple rows per employee capture all their KRAs. Weightage per employee must sum to 100. Self & Manager scores are 0–100 (leave blank if not yet assessed).

    Budget Editor Panel

    Manage appraisal budget allocation for each reporting manager · Human Capital access only

    Human Capital Only
    How Budget Allocation Works
    Each manager is allocated a budget % of their team's eligible CTC for appraisal increments. The default is 10%. Use the Edit button to override a manager's budget. Changes take effect immediately across all budget panels and calculations.
    Manager Budget Allocations
    Click Edit on any row to change that manager's appraisal budget %
    Default (10%) Custom
